thread:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — yesterday's chain outage hit three surfaces (cloud region flaps, auth provider rate limits, model-registry write errors). I dumped the raw timeline in the doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-4567/postmortem. Action items below, need owners and dates.

Devon: +1. I'll own the cloud-side mitigations. Planned tasks: add multi-region failover to the control plane, formalize provider contact rotation, and validate cross-region storage fallback. Target: 2026-03-26 EOD. @Morgan can you add the provider SLA rotation to the oncall runbook? :calendar:

Rajesh: I'll take model-registry durability and fallback. Plan is: enable read-only replicas in region B, add a hot-cache replica for recent model metadata, and implement a best-effort write-queue that flushes to registry when primary is degraded. ETA: 2026-03-27. I'll open a PR for the write-queue library today.

Anya: I'll own auth-provider mitigations. Immediate steps: implement token refresh backoff, add an emergency fallback client with reduced scopes, and rotate client secrets per the postmortem notes. Target for rotation + fallback: 2026-03-25 noon. I'll coordinate with Security for KMS key rotation. @Luis please add the new alerts for auth latencies. :lock:

Luis: On it. I'll add two alerts: (1) auth error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, (2) model-registry write latency P95 > 2.0s for 3m. I'll also update the runbook with exact paging thresholds and a quick checklist for escalation to provider contacts. Alert rule (placeholder):
```yaml
- name: AuthHighErrorRate
  expr: sum(rate(auth_provider_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(auth_requests[5m])) > 0.005
  for: 5m
- name: ModelRegistryHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(registry_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 2.0
  for: 3m
```
I'll post the PR by EOD today.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4567 created, severity: sev2. Postmortem uploaded by Morgan. Pager duty rotation updated: https://pd.redwood/internal/rotations.

Morgan: Thanks — please confirm ownerships in this thread so I can sync into JIRA and assign deadlines. Also note we observed a recurring pattern: provider auth rate limiting spikes precede registry write errors by ~1–2 minutes. Suggest we add a recurring 90-day review on vendor SLAs and runbook drills.

Devon: Confirmed. I'll add the SLA rotation ticket and schedule a provider test on 2026-04-02.

Rajesh: Confirmed. Opening JIRA: RW-REG-318. Will include test harness for the write-queue and add integration smoke tests to CI.

Anya: Confirmed. RW-AUTH-224 created for secret rotation + fallback client. I'll notify Security and request a KMS window.

Luis: Confirmed. RW-OBS-99 for alerting + runbook changes. I will also add a dashboard panel showing the auth -> registry correlation.

Morgan: Outstanding items: (a) provider contact rotation added to runbook (Devon), (b) KMS window scheduled (Anya), (c) test harness merged (Rajesh), (d) alert PR merged (Luis). I'll check back Friday for status and will schedule a 30-min sync if any of these slip. Meeting invite: https://calendar.redwood/meet/abc123 (Fri 09:30).

Devon: quick note — while adding multi-region failover we need to validate GPU model access paths for Dedicated customers. I'll add a subtask for model-serving routing.

Rajesh: Good call. I'll ensure the write-queue respects model version pins and doesn't accidentally promote incomplete uploads.

Anya: Also: recommend adding an automated smoke test that calls the auth provider with a low-QPS client to detect throttling before it impacts main flows. I'll prototype this by Wed.

Luis: Will add the smoke test as an optional step in the canary pipeline.

Morgan: Great. If anyone needs more time, call it out here. Otherwise I'll update the incident with owners & JIRA links and close the follow-up loop on Friday. :thumbsup:
